protocol.baseline: per-task most common training answer, lexical tie break; no test labels or pretrained models

data.admission: Exactly the PR14 independently verified finite scalar projections; unchanged facts, carriers and parent family/split assignments. Arithmetic texts are the control.
data.correlation: Sibling projections and carriers are correlated; report per-task counts and family macro, never treat projection count as independent sample size.
data.order: Rank parents by SHA256 canonical seed/item using the parent ordering_identity; within each parent visit count,sum,squares or traversal-value,x,y,z. Repeat the full fixed child cycle. Equal updates and scored-target ceilings across lanes, not equal exposure to the historical composed corpus.

protocol.decision: Train the prepared scalar corpus from random initialization with the previously exposed constant 0.001/4096-update budget. Fixed parent-rank then projection order, no result-dependent schedule or task selection.
protocol.diagnostics: train only; inherited validation history aliases training examples; no validation/test model calls during updates
protocol.evaluation: All 27 training workers terminate first. One fresh evaluation worker verifies all training checkpoints and regenerates predictions/loss, writes the decision, and evaluates the full matrix only if eligible. It validates authorization once for the whole bounded matrix, not by caching verifier success.

gates.cost_margin: paired training wall ratio <=1.25; latent float32 byte ratio <=1; descriptive only
gates.failure: any missing/failed worker or invalid pairing suppresses aggregates; dense train floor failure blocks held-out scoring for every lane
gates.learning_adequate: scalar-only diagnostic: all seeds/tasks train >=0.90, test >=0.50 and >= training-majority +0.10; composed adequacy remains false
gates.quality_margin: quantized minus dense scalar family macro >=-0.05; descriptive; no automatic format selection
gates.test_unlock: all dense workload/seed cells verified and every task train exact answer+EOS >=0.90; all 27 training workers terminate first; decision retained before any held-out evaluation

protocol.phase5: Always false: scalar learning is a prerequisite diagnostic; original composed-output assessment requires a separately declared protocol.
protocol.primary: Final-step prompt-only unconstrained greedy scalar complete answer plus EOS. No original composed-output model calls in this increment.
protocol.scope: Exploratory family-held-out scalar characterization on visible finite development examples. Scalar success does not establish composed-output learning adequacy, fresh confirmatory capability, geometry benefit, quantum advantage or packed savings.
protocol.selection: Final update only; no early stopping, validation selection, held-out tuning, automatic format selection or composed-output assessment.

training.selection: final-step; no early stopping; no test evaluation

protocol.uncertainty: raw counts, paired seed differences, mean/min/max; descriptive only
